meta.name: security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件与链接，输出安全放行或拒绝的判定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要先审文件或链接是否安全再决定放行
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, return pass or reject verdicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before approving access

howto.what: 装上后，任何文件或 URL 进入系统前会先做安全合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定和扫描报告（含命中的黑名单项、许可状态、风险等级），并写入 trace_id 留痕。
howto.when: 文件或 URL 进入文档处理流水线时，由锦衣卫 Worker 作为第一道闸门自动调用；也可直接运行脚本入口手动触发。

say.note: 返回 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告

say.text: 检查这个 URL 是否合规：https://example.com/paper
say.note: 先解析域名，再比对黑名单

say.text: 用 policy_ref 指定另一套合规规则，重扫这个文件
say.note: 覆盖默认策略后重新给出判定

howto.what_en: Once installed, every file or URL is scanned for security and compliance before entering the system, returning a pass/reject verdict plus a report with blacklist hits, license status and risk level, and a trace_id for provenance.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the Jinyiwei worker whenever a file or URL reaches the document pipeline, acting as the first gate before any processing; it can also be run manually through its script entry point.

say_en.note: Returns a pass/reject verdict and a scan report

say_en.text: Check whether this URL is compliant: https://example.com/paper
say_en.note: Resolves the domain, then checks the blacklist

say_en.text: Rescan this file with a custom policy_ref
say_en.note: Overrides the default compliance rule set
